title: Online Safety Basics
intro: Learn how to protect your personal information, accounts and digital identity online.
topic1_text: Learn how to create secure passwords and protect your accounts from unauthorized access.
topic2_text: Learn about scams, phishing messages and unsafe websites.
topic3_text: Learn what information should be private and how to share data safely.
topic4_text: Learn responsible and secure habits while using online platforms.
practice: Review your account security settings and improve your password safety.
